hook: Karimnagar MBBS students back on strike after *Nov 20* hostel deadline missed
hook_b: Karimnagar MBBS students back on strike after *Nov 20* hostel deadline missed
tldr: MBBS students of Government Medical College, Karimnagar resumed an indefinite peaceful strike on November 21 after neither the boys' nor girls' hostel was handed over by the November 20 deadline officials had given.

beats.what: Students say there is no fully working permanent college building, too few classrooms, and labs, exam halls and washrooms are inadequate.
beats.why: They had deferred a strike on November 2 after officials assured hostel handover by November 20.
beats.care: Students also lack dedicated college buses for classes and clinical postings.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Students want the permanent campus handed over by the second week of January 2027.

facts.t: Students want dedicated buses for *all four* MBBS batches for classes and clinical postings.

viz.verdict: Deadline missed; students back on strike
